title: Draw.io
descript: Draw.io is a full-featured diagram editor in the browser: flowcharts, network diagrams, UML, wireframes and org charts, with a large shape library and export to PNG/SVG/PDF. It runs entirely on your NAS with no account, no tracking and no cloud dependency; your diagrams stay in your browser or in the files you export.
release_note: 1. First release: Draw.io 32.6.10 from Docker Hub as a non-root container. Complete diagram editor with shape libraries and PNG/SVG/PDF export; nothing is stored server-side.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). Open the web UI and start drawing - diagrams are kept in the browser's local storage and in the files you export, so export important ones or use File > Save as. No account, no cloud storage and no server-side document store is involved. The UI is plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.

github.description: Dockerized draw.io based on whichever is the most secure image at the time.

zh-cn.descript: Draw.io 是浏览器里的全能绘图工具：流程图、网络拓扑、UML、线框图、组织架构图都能画，内置大量图形库，可导出 PNG/SVG/PDF。它完全跑在你的 NAS 上，不需要账号、不追踪、不依赖云服务；图表保存在浏览器本地或你导出的文件里。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会自动安装）。打开界面即可绘图——图表保存在浏览器本地存储和你导出的文件里，重要图表请及时导出或使用「文件 > 另存为」。整个过程不涉及账号、云存储或服务端文档库。界面为纯 HTTP，暴露到公网前请配置带 TLS 的反向代理。
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 首个版本：基于 Docker Hub 的 Draw.io 32.6.10，以非 root 容器运行。完整绘图编辑器，内置图形库并支持 PNG/SVG/PDF 导出；服务端不保存任何文档。

zh-hk.descript: Draw.io 是瀏覽器裡的全能繪圖工具：流程圖、網路拓撲、UML、線框圖、組織架構圖都能畫，內建大量圖形庫，可匯出 PNG/SVG/PDF。它完全跑在你的 NAS 上，不需要帳號、不追蹤、不依賴雲端服務；圖表保存在瀏覽器本地或你匯出的檔案裡。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動安裝）。開啟介面即可繪圖——圖表保存在瀏覽器本地儲存和你匯出的檔案裡，重要圖表請及時匯出或使用「檔案 > 另存為」。整個過程不涉及帳號、雲端儲存或伺服器端文件庫。介面為純 HTTP，公開到互聯網前請配置帶 TLS 的反向代理。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首個版本：基於 Docker Hub 的 Draw.io 32.6.10，以非 root 容器運行。完整繪圖編輯器，內建圖形庫並支援 PNG/SVG/PDF 匯出；伺服器端不保存任何文件。

data_notes: Draw.io keeps no documents on the server: the `/data` mount is reserved for the image's optional runtime files, and diagrams live in the browser's local storage or in the files you export.
design_notes: **Runs as uid 1000.** The image's default `tomcat` user already matches the TOS application user, so no wrapper is needed.
**Stateless by design.** There is no server-side document store; the app is a static editor plus export.
limitations: - Diagrams are stored in the browser (local storage) or in exported files - the server keeps no copy.
- The UI is plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.
- Real-time collaboration and cloud-storage integrations need extra services that this package does not bundle.
